Principle 5: A Typical Day
Before I Go to Work
Usually I sleep late, so it is very hard for me to get up.
I strive to exercise every morning, but it is hard because I don’t get up on time.
I exercise as much as I can.
I often go to work without eating breakfast.
The Morning at the Office
When I get to work, I usually do paperwork.
Sometimes my boss gives me too much work to do, and it can be very stressful for me.
When I complete a task, it makes me very happy.
I work inside all day on the computer and do not go outside very often at work.
The Afternoon at the Office
After lunch, I’m sleepy and feel like having a nap, but I can’t.
I am busy in the afternoons and sometimes have appointments outside of the office.
At the end of the day, I need to report what I had done that day to my boss.
We typically finish work at 6:00 p.m., but sometimes there is more work, and I stay to work overtime.
After Work and At Night
I usually eat dinner with my co-workers after work.
Otherwise, I go directly home and spend time with my family.
My family is always happy to see me, and my busy day and stress are forgotten.
